preconditions: principal enrolled with policy ecdsa-p256-sha256
cases.stimulus: submit a correctly structured request signed by an RSA key while labeling it ecdsa-p256-sha256
expected: request rejected before authorization/state mutation
actual key type is independently checked
forbidden: acceptance based only on alg label
nonce/state consumption after failed key validation

preconditions: principal enrolled with policy ecdsa-p256-sha256
cases.stimulus: submit request signed by P-384 EC key labeled ecdsa-p256-sha256
expected: request rejected before authorization/state mutation
curve is verified as P-256
forbidden: successful authentication

preconditions: valid phone-client authentication
target operation is host-only or targets another recipient
cases.stimulus: submit authenticated cross-role or cross-recipient operation
expected: authorization denial
no protected state mutation
forbidden: authentication treated as permission
caller-controlled direction overrides role-derived direction

preconditions: one valid signed request has already succeeded
cases.stimulus: replay the identical request with identical nonce and signature
expected: second request rejected as replay
original committed result remains unchanged
forbidden: second business mutation

preconditions: same endpoint signing identity can be known to two relay installations
cases.stimulus: replay a valid protected request from relay A against relay B at the same method/path
expected: request bound to intended relay installation and rejected by B
forbidden: acceptance solely because nonce is unused on B

preconditions: valid signer and protected body endpoint
cases.stimulus: alter one received body byte without updating Content-Digest/signature
expected: digest verification fails before authorization/state mutation
forbidden: parsing/mutating based on unsigned altered bytes

preconditions: VeraMesh declares SHA-256-only Content-Digest policy
cases.stimulus: send a Content-Digest dictionary containing sha-256 plus an additional algorithm member
expected: all conforming implementations make the same accept/reject decision
forbidden: Node accepts while Android/Python rejects or vice versa because policy was unspecified

preconditions: five-minute freshness design requirement
cases.stimulus: test created/expires exactly on each configured time boundary and just outside it
expected: all implementations apply identical inclusive/exclusive boundary rules and maximum lifetime
forbidden: language-specific clock-window disagreement

preconditions: single unconsumed pairing session/token
cases.stimulus: redeem the same pairing token concurrently from two clients
expected: at most one principal/key binding commits
loser observes deterministic rejection
token consumption and enrollment are atomic
forbidden: two enrolled principals from one token
partially created principal without consumed token/audit

preconditions: pairing session predetermines phone-client role/scopes
cases.stimulus: redeeming client requests relay-admin or host scopes
expected: requested escalation rejected or ignored in favor of predetermined grant
forbidden: remote client self-selects stronger role

preconditions: recipient trusts sender signing key
relay knows recipient HPKE public key
cases.stimulus: relay or attacker creates a fresh HPKE-valid ciphertext for recipient without a valid sender inner signature
expected: recipient decrypts if cryptographically valid but rejects message authorship before application processing
forbidden: HPKE base-mode ciphertext accepted as proof of sender identity

preconditions: same logical JSON data can be serialized with different insignificant whitespace/key ordering
cases.stimulus: recipient parses and reserializes signed inner JSON before verification
expected: normative profile defines exact signed bytes so verification never depends on reconstructed JSON
forbidden: implementation-specific JSON canonicalization assumptions

preconditions: sender/message-id pair already accepted with envelope hash H1
cases.stimulus: submit same sender/message-id with different immutable envelope hash H2
expected: idempotency conflict
original stored envelope remains unchanged
forbidden: duplicate success hiding changed content
overwrite of original envelope

preconditions: relay commits message acceptance but response is lost
cases.stimulus: sender retries same message identity/content using a fresh HTTP nonce/signature
expected: relay returns semantically equivalent original custody result
no duplicate immutable message row
forbidden: second business acceptance
requirement that nondeterministic ECDSA signature bytes be identical unless exact signed receipt was durably persisted

preconditions: recipient has received a valid sealed envelope
cases.stimulus: recipient attempts to emit durable-storage receipt before durable inbox write
expected: conforming recipient implementation orders durable write before receipt creation
forbidden: receipt proves storage that can be lost immediately on process death

preconditions: relay has message but no valid recipient-signed durable-storage receipt
cases.stimulus: relay fabricates or substitutes recipient_received evidence
expected: sender/GC logic rejects receipt lacking valid recipient signature and binding
forbidden: relay alone can cause recipient-received proposition to become true

preconditions: relay GC is gated by valid recipient durable-storage evidence
cases.stimulus: recipient sends storage acknowledgement only inside an HPKE-opaque application envelope
expected: protocol has separate relay-verifiable non-secret custody evidence if relay GC depends on it
forbidden: relay claims verification of plaintext/signature fields it cannot inspect

preconditions: endpoint receives relay-signed acceptance receipt
cases.stimulus: receipt is signed by an otherwise valid but previously untrusted relay custody key
expected: endpoint rejects custody claim unless relay installation/key binding is trusted from pairing/bootstrap
forbidden: any valid P-256 key can impersonate trusted relay custody

preconditions: relay has transactional SQLite ledger
cases.stimulus: kill process after durable DB commit but before HTTP response delivery
expected: restart preserves committed acceptance
retry reconciles by stable message identity
forbidden: timeout interpreted as proof of rollback

preconditions: audit/security-integrity verification is failed
cases.stimulus: attempt security-sensitive state mutation
expected: write is blocked until integrity is reconciled
forbidden: 0005 behavior: health red while sensitive writes continue

preconditions: old HPKE key epoch still has unresolved queued envelopes
cases.stimulus: rotate to new HPKE epoch and immediately destroy old private key
expected: implementation prevents or delays destruction until old-epoch envelopes are durably resolved/expired per policy
forbidden: rotation silently renders accepted pending envelopes undecryptable
